Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers must review the companion animal process before they arrive at the desk, so boarding can proceed safely and without delay.

Safety remains the first concern on every journey. Please ensure your animal is secured in the approved carrier, with clear labels and current travel papers ready for review. The cabin team will monitor animals during flight, and the passenger coordinator will guide you through the required steps in a calm and orderly way. <<FACT F028>> Keep your animal close and follow staff direction at all times.

Please also use the pet relief area before check-in when possible, and keep the lead attached whenever your animal is outside the carrier. <<FACT F016>> If your animal shows signs of stress, let staff know at once so we can help.

We appreciate your cooperation and patience, and we will do our best to support a smooth journey for you and your companion.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel begins.
